title: Senior Wellness Plan Recheck Cycle and Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Supply
content:
For a pet on a senior wellness plan, the planned supply days of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy shipment under Tailwise Autoship are counted on the pet's recheck cycle before they are turned into packages. The wellness plan is read from the pet's Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans record, and the class of the linked prescription from the Tailwise Pharmacy prescription on file.

## Rule

| The pet linked to the subscription | Linked prescription class | Planned supply days |
|---|---|---|
| Holds a Senior Cat Wellness Plan or Senior Dog Wellness Plan in status active | Rx Maintenance Medication | Cut down to whole blocks of 14 days |
| Holds such a senior plan in status active | Any other class | Capped at the days left from the day of the re-set to the last day of that wellness plan's current term, when the plan's annual exam falls |
| Any other pet | any | Used as worked out |

"Cut down to whole blocks of 14 days" means the largest multiple of 14 that does not exceed the planned supply days. "Capped" means the lower of the planned supply days and the calendar days from the day of the re-set to the last day of the plan's current term. The figure is the planned supply days as they stand when they are turned into packages.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Planned supply days | Senior plan | Prescription class | Days left in the plan term | Counted supply days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 51 | Yes | Rx Maintenance Medication | — | 42 |
| 56 | Yes | Rx Maintenance Medication | — | 56 |
| 13 | Yes | Rx Maintenance Medication | — | 0 |
| 51 | Yes | Rx Preventive | 40 | 40 |
| 51 | Yes | Rx Preventive | 75 | 51 |
| 51 | No (Adult Dog Wellness Plan) | Rx Maintenance Medication | — | 51 |
